summary: Shows human_readable converting byte counts to strings like 10.00 KB, with isbits and unit options, verified via assert.
questions: How do I convert bytes to a human-readable size?
How do I show a size in gigabits?

answer_card.title: human_readable
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ 10240 | human_readable }}                            # "10.00 KB"
{{ 102400000 | human_readable(unit="G") }}              # "0.10 GB"
{{ 102400000 | human_readable(isbits=True, unit="G") }} # "0.10 Gb"
{{ 1 | human_readable(isbits=True) }}                   # "1.00 bits"
```
